pattern_txt=re.compile(r'/home/james/bills/electricity/'+str(year)+r'-\d{2}\.txt$')
pattern_pdf=re.compile(r'/home/james/bills/electricity/'+str(year)+r'-\d{2}\.pdf$')
electricity_txt=sorted([p for p in paths if pattern_txt.search(p)])

def extract_total_amount(file_content):
    # look for 'Total Amount' line
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', file_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'Total\s*Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', file_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))
    return None

# Extract from txt files
results=[]
for p in electricity_txt:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content=f.get('content','')
    total=extract_total_amount(content)
    results.append((p,total,content[:200]))
print('txt extraction')
for p,total,_ in results:
    print(p, total)

# Extract from pdf files
results_pdf=[]
for p in electricity_pdf:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    content=f.get('content','')
    total=extract_total_amount(content)
    results_pdf.append((p,total,type(content),len(content)))
print('pdf extraction')
for p,total,typ,l in results_pdf:
    print(p, 'total', total, 'type', typ, 'len', l)

paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')
pattern_txt=re.compile(r'/home/james/bills/electricity/'+str(year)+r'-\d{2}\.txt$')

import re
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year
paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True, entry_type='all')
pattern_txt=re.compile(r'/home/james/bills/electricity/'+str(year)+r'-\d{2}\.txt$')
electricity_txt=sorted([p for p in paths if pattern_txt.search(p)])

def extract_total_amount(file_content):
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', file_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))
    m=re.search(r'Total\s*Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', file_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))
    return None

amounts=[]
for p in electricity_txt:
    f=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=p)
    total=extract_total_amount(f.get('content',''))
    amounts.append(total)
    print(p.split('/')[-1], total)

sum_total=sum(a for a in amounts if a is not None)
print('year', year, 'count_txt', len(electricity_txt), 'sum_total', sum_total)
